title: Vector and Protocol
author: Rosalind Nakamura
blurb: Cyrus Vane, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
